baseRankLegend: This deal starts at {{rank}}; the rank below it ({{prev}}) comes last (K wraps to A)
supermoveLimitTooltip: Only {{limit}} card(s) can be moved at once ({{cells}} free cell(s), {{cols}} empty column(s))
supermoveBadgeTooltip: Max cards movable at once ({{cells}} free cell(s), {{cols}} empty column(s)). More free space allows moving more
emptyColLimitTooltip: An empty column takes at most {{limit}} cards (selected: {{size}})

tutorial.freeCells: Seven free cells. Three start occupied after the deal. More empty cells allow moving more cards at once.
tutorial.foundation: Foundation piles. Build each suit from the base rank upward, wrapping K to A.
tutorial.tableau: Tableau columns. Cards must be stacked in the SAME suit descending, wrapping K to A. Only the rank before the base rank may move to empty columns.
tutorial.resetButton: Press the reset button to start a new game.

landscapeBanner: Rotate to landscape for easier play

frontendHint.moveToFoundation: A card can be moved to the foundation
frontendHint.freeCellsNearlyFull: Free cells are almost full — try to clear some
frontendHint.useEmptyColumn: An empty column is available — move the pre-base-rank card to use it
frontendHint.useFreeCells: Consider moving a card to a free cell to open up moves
